explanation: Javanese makers mix cooked soya beans with spores of a Rhizopus mould, whose white threads bind the beans into a solid block in a day or two.

claims.text: Tempeh comes from Indonesia, specifically the island of Java.
Tempeh is not a Japanese, Korean or Thai food.
Tempeh is made by inoculating cooked soya beans with a Rhizopus mould.
The mould's white threads bind the beans into a solid cake in about one to two days.
